root_cause: CountAvailableForRule filters q.status = 'active'. Questions are created in 'draft' status by default. Users who haven't transitioned questions through draft → review → active will always see 0 available when trying to publish an exam with random rules. The backend validation is correct (consistent with session question selection), but the error message gives no actionable guidance.
fix_description: Added a descriptive hint paragraph in Step4Review.tsx under the unsatisfied-rules list that is shown when any rule reports available=0. Hint explains that only 'active' questions count and directs users to the Question Bank. Added i18n keys in all 3 locales. Added regression test TestPublish_ZeroAvailableActiveQuestions_ReturnsValidationError.
